name: orchestrator
description: The overnight autonomous EPIC loop: /enable-orchestrator (six verified preconditions), /kickoff (daily driver), /plan (DoD authoring + independent review), /run (run-to-completion with risk-gated auto-merge), /disable-orchestrator; planner + integration-checker agents; dod-verify + nightly-orchestrator workflows; runtime, risk-policy, CODEOWNERS and digest templates.

board_token.title: Board API token (Jira or Notion — the headless adapter lane)
board_token.description: API token for the Jira/Notion board (headless adapter lane). Stored in the OS keychain; exported as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BOARD_TOKEN.

plugin_repo_url.description: Marketplace repo URL the CI runner fetches the orchestrator plugin from (feeds ORCH_PLUGIN_REPO_URL).
